  AGENDA
  Advisory Committee/ Naming or Renaming of a Public Facility

  OPENING CEREMONIES – 11:30 A.M.

  Call to Order

  Roll Call

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEMS

  Persons wishing to address the Advisory Committee for Naming or Renaming a Public Facility on any
  item on today’s agenda, may do so at this time.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  This item will be acted upon as a whole unless called upon by a Member of the Advisory Committee.
 City of Inglewood  August 1, 2019
Advisory Committee/Naming or Renaming of a Public Facility

  1.  PARKS, RECREATION and COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  Approval to rename the Edward Vincent Park Tennis complex.
  Recommendation:
  1) Approve application regarding Donald Bly; and
  2) Direct City Clerk to present the findings to the City Council at the appropriate
  meeting.

  APPOINTMENTS TO BOARDS, COMMISSIONS, AND COMMITTEES

  PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS

  Persons wishing to address the Advisory Committee for Naming or Renaming of a Public Facility on any
  matter not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Persons with complaints
  regarding City management or departmental operations are requested to submit those complaints first to
  the City Manager for resolution.

  ADVISORY COMMITTEE COMMENTS

  The members of the Advisory Committee for Naming or Renaming of a Public Facility will provide oral
  reports to address any matters they deem of general interest to the public.

  ADJOURNMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  In the event that today’s meeting of the Advisory Committee for Naming or Renaming of a Public
  Facility is not held, agenda items will automatically be continued to the next regularly scheduled
  Advisory Committee meeting. If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, or need
  translation services, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (310) 412-5280 or FAX (310) 412-
  5533, One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All requests
  for special accommodations must be received 72 hours prior to the day of the Council Meetings.
